notes.title: TINY TEAMS 2025 | DEMO | About the development
notes.content:
[h3][b]TINY TEAMS 2025 is just around the corner! August 7–14![/b][/h3]

We are so excited to tell you that Shinehill will be part of the Tiny Teams 2025 festival!
A [u][b]demo will be available[/b][/u] during the festival, and the game will be [u][b]20% off[/b][/u].
(We will share more details about the demo and the game’s development below)

Tiny Teams is a great festival dedicated to games developed by tiny studios, and we’re thrilled to be part of it this year!
Be sure to check out the Tiny Teams 2025 sale page, there will be tons of cool games from tiny teams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/1489e2571af6f572a2cbd3a95f1f41cb7aa3367a.png[/img]

[h3][b]In the demo, you can:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] meet 16 residents of Shinehill;
[*] explore the village and its nearby surroundings;
[*] complete several side quests;
[*] grow crops;
[*] cook delicious meals;
[*] battle wild animals;
[*] and even play the beginning of the main story!
[/list]
[h3][b]Current state of the EA version of the game and what content does it include:[/b][/h3]
During this time we have added many technical improvements to make the game better: mouse controls, obstacle avoidance, quest tracking, fast travel, and more. We’ve also been gradually adding new content.

[b]Details about the game’s content:[/b][list]
[*] main storyline
[*] 16 charming NPCs to befriend (and more!)
[*] each NPC has 2–3 side quests
[*] daily quest board
[*] 1 festival
[*] home decor and plot decorations
[*] pets
[*] farming
[*] fishing
[*] combat
[*] dungeons
[/list]
[h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] First of all we plan to add final main story quests, as well as additional side quests for all NPCs and more romance options.

[*] New festivals and more NPC-related content.

[*] Character customization. More specifically, it will likely be more character appearance to choose from. We plan to add this feauture closer to the release of version 1.0, in one of the final updates.

[*] Improving minigames and adding new ones, plus various technical upgrades. We will finally have arcade machine in the tavern!

[*] And of course, better localization! There’s already a lot of text, and soon there’ll be even more. Unfortunately, some languages are still only translated via Google Translate (about 60% for certain languages).
If you know Chinese, Korean, or Japanese and want to help, we'd be very happy! Please email us peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com or message us on [url=https://discord.gg/TWNH7krZcq]Discord[/url], and we’ll explain everything. (We will also make a post with more details on how translation is done and how you can contribute.)
Thank you to all our wonderful volunteers! We love you!

[*] We may have forgotten to mention something, as we still have a lot to do both on the story and the technical side. We’ll be sure to share what we’ve added or changed in updates, so stay tuned for news!
[/list]

We’re always grateful for your feedback. Shinehill has come this far thanks to your suggestions and ideas! Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/e39b3c706158b318fcfdd6b720b3fea7bdecfe78.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE Ver. 0.5.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
The second major update was released today! Very excited to tell you more about it:
[h3][b]New system of interacting with NPCs:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability to hug/kiss NPCs
[*] You can gift NPCs any items
[*] You can acces the store through NPCs
[*] Friendship log
[*] Tracking of side quests
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/2d0e14d974cccae4119cae463667b24a8e9ecff3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Obstacle avoidance system for the player:[/b][/h3]
We've been wanting to add this for a long time and we finally made it! The new collision detection and avoidance system will help you not to get stuck in objects. Your character will automatically walk around the obstacle from the nearest possible angle.
It will be much more comfortable to play this way!

[h3][b]New decoration system[/b][/h3] (just talk to the mayor):
[list]
[*] You can choose the color of the roof
[*] You can choose the color of the walls inside the house
[*] You can upgrade the furniture inside the house
[*] New items for decorating the farm
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/15adb4d9d0fa8334e2093dd6361b53a04f64cded.png[/img]

[h3][b]Other updates:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]The first festival in Shinehill[/u][/b]
[*] Added swordfish
[*] Added penguin (pet)
[*] Added eggplant[/list]
[b]Bugfixes, etc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added X button to exit menus everywhere
[*] Inventory acces by Esc button
[*] Removed the invisible wall at the daily quest board
[*] Every morning quest pop up appears
[*] Number of items is now displayed when confirming actions with said item
[*] Huge pumpkin drops 7 to 10 seeds
[*] Simplified sand swimmer
[*] Simplified starfish
[*] Boris sells ruff that's needed for the main storyline
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to create a seedbed with open inventory
[/list]
We really hope you enjoy these updates!
If you have any questions or encounter any difficulties, please post them on Steam discussions or on our Discord!

We've also started preparations for a small change in the game interfaces so that players on SteamDeck can see everything clearly. We hope that we will be able to release this update soon!

Thank you for being with us and have a nice day!

notes.title: About the major update #1 | DEVLOG

I'd like to talk more about the upcoming Shinehill update!
[h3]The first major update is scheduled for November 27th.[/h3]
What are we working on now? What will be in the update?

[h3]The finale of the main story:[/h3]
You will learn the whole truth! 
The main story will increase by about 30%. It will include 2 new boss battles and an interesting narrative!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/659ec9b84db51d6c41f0b80af7559b19ac08d8fc.png[/img]

[h3]New quests with the villagers!  [/h3]
In this update, we're adding romantic date quests with Rudy, Crystal, Lucy and Pinky.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/892d0e8090f9504654a3711e566f0c65d43be40d.png[/img]

[h3]Teleports!!![/h3]
You asked for them - we made them!
Teleporting will cost you disguise points, so be careful.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/8a47d65f71a59e30ddd6c087ec97feeb970dd504.png[/img]

[h3]New mobs in the locations:[/h3]
The mountain and winter coast will now be filled with mobs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/b9040bb8b06970ef991f4e0a9a2cf6590554324c.png[/img]


What will be added later (this list may grow based on your suggestions): 
[list]
[*] New side quests (each NPC has 4-5 quests planned) 
[*] Character customization - There will be more “human costumes” to choose from 
[*] Full mouse support 
[*] Festivals 
[*] New pets 
[*] More crops to grow 
[*] Ask NPCs out for a date (in the future, possibly marriage as well) 
[*] Events after the final main quest 
[*] And more things that we will decide on with the community!

[*] Improved localization! 
The translation process has already started, we will post more details about recruiting volunteers a little later. But if you want to start now - please write us an email! 
peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com
[/list]

We would also like to say a huge [b]thank you to everyone[/b]! 
Thank you for playing Shinehill and supporting us! We are very happy!
We wish you all the best and see you soon! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/e39b3c706158b318fcfdd6b720b3fea7bdecfe78.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev. Diary - April+May
notes.content:
[b][i]Hi everyone! We have an update on the progress and approximate release date for the game![/i]

[h3]Innovations:[/h3][/b]
[list][*] [u]Map[/u]
Many people said it would be handy to add a map. Shinehill Island is not that big, so we originally wanted to limit ourselves to just signposts, but we decided to add a map as well. In addition, it's much more convenient to see if any of the villagers have quests.
[*] [u]Added character level[/u]
Previously, the player could develop his character and increase his skills only by buying potions to increase parameters. Now the player gets experience for almost all his actions and increasing the level gets a skill point, which can be distributed in any of the parameters. You can do your favorite fishing or farming, but at the same time become very strong!
[*] [u]The main plot is finished[/u]
The main plot is finally finished! We've been thinking for a long time about exactly how we want this story to end and have finally come to a decision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/b7f5525d284ae6dd7342e615d2dbb693ab56702a.png[/img]
[*] [u]Books and Notes[/u]
[*] [u]Recipes hidden around the world[/u]
[*] [u]Finalized all locations and all mobs[/u].
[*] [u]3 dungeons with riddles and bosses[/u]
[*] [u]Houses of all villagers[/u]
[*] [u]Functional collection system[/u]
[*] [u]New visual effects[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/edf1ce82cb584733fcf6e7d0c8527eb5d9b9e141.png[/img][/list]
[h3][b]We're working on it now:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Finalizing the mini-games of the main storyline
[*] Battle with the 3rd boss
[*] Game balance in general (item prices, mob difficulty, character progression)
[*] Thinking about adding content after reaching 100% friendship level.
[*] New emotions in dialog images of NPCs
[*] Farm repair
[*] Music and soundtrack for everything
[*] Menu refinement
[/list]
[h3][b]About the release date:[/b][/h3]
We were planning to go into early access at the end of July. But at the moment we think we need to refine and finalize everything more thoroughly. And then also to test and make a million more edits :)
So we'd like to move the release a few months ahead!
We know how much you're looking forward to the release of Shinehill, we're really, really looking forward to it too! And we just have to not let you down and deliver a quality game!
[b][i]We are currently targeting [u]September 2024![/u]. 
Don't be disappointed and please wait a little longer![/i][/b]

[i]If you have any questions, suggestions, or issues with the game, please write to us at peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com .
With your emails, comments and discussions on Steam you motivate us a lot! [/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889890/Shinehill/

notes.title: Dev. Diary - February+March
notes.content:
[b]It's been a while since we last wrote - all this time we've been diligently working on the game![/b]

As of today, a lot has already been completed:
[list]
[*] The order board is up and running, issuing daily quests.
[*] The gift-giving system is completed. Each villager in the village has their own preferences.
[*] Cooking and recipe book. Recipes can be found scattered throughout the world. Some can be learned while completing tasks.
[*] You can now adopt cute pets and pet them every day!
[*] New locations with their own flora and fauna have been added.
[*] We have made some changes to the controls by adding mouse control. More specifically, we have added variety. You can use either the left mouse button or J. However, we highly recommend playing with a gamepad.
[*] Tooltips have been added.
[*] and more
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/656cdadd7fe63aa28f6b27fba2e18697cdc00491.png[/img]

[b]About the game's readiness stage:[/b]
Almost 30% of additional tasks are ready, including romantic date quests with NPCs.

The main storyline is currently about 70% complete. We are actively working on it to finish it as soon as possible and conduct enough testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/34f51803fbba306b90c0c760e5cc984dc7fb1d3a.png[/img]
[b]About the release date:[/b]
In July, it will be 2 years since we started developing the game. Therefore, we would really like to release it in early access this July. We hope everything works out. We will provide precise dates later!

[i]We apologize for the infrequent news updates and thank you so much for being with us! Only with your support can we continue our work, and Shinehill will be able to see the world![/i]
[i]
If you have any questions, suggestions, or issues with the game, please write to us at peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com .
[/i]

As a result, we have decided to update the demo build!
The demo is still just a small part of the game, but it gives a better idea of what to expect from the full version.
We always greatly appreciate your feedback. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Shinehill at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879391/279f7cb241f42e2d7f88cf3998b7415e53923c82.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that Shinehill will be participating in the Steam Next Fest. Everyone will have the opportunity to try the [u]demo version[/u] of Shinehill!

[b]About the game:[/b]
Shinehill is a narrative adventure with an open world. The main protagonist is an alien who has a dislike for humans and is sent on an important mission to Earth. Due to circumstances, he find themselves on the island of Shinehill and are now forced to work undercover while carrying out their mission, simultaneously fulfilling tasks for the local inhabitants. Various game mechanics will assist you in accomplishing the main character's mission or simply provide a relaxing and enjoyable experience!

What to expect in the Shinehill Demo:
[list]
[*] Meeting, befriending, and interacting with village residents
[*] Quests and activities
[*] Fishing and interesting mini-games
[*] A small farm
[*] Resource gathering
[*] Cooking
[*] Battles with forest inhabitants
[*] Books containing tales and legends of the island
[*] Sunsets and sunrises
[*] Several houses and locations
[/list]

And this is just a small part of what will be in the full version of the game. We will tell you more about what exactly will be in it a little later, so stay tuned for updates!

[b]We hope that you will have a great time in Shinehill.[/b]

If you have any questions, suggestions, or issues with the game, please write to us at peachbitegamestudio@gmail.com .
